label: Esos system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Esos locus represented by a VCA0450 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Esos branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0450 genes, VCA0450 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Esos locus, unresolved Esos trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
